exposure: Pelvic Organ Prolapse Quantification measurements of pelvic organ support
Women who achieved uncomplicated spontaneous vaginal delivery
Women who did not achieve uncomplicated spontaneous vaginal delivery
finding: Greater maternal adaptations in the vagina during pregnancy, including vaginal descent and higher first-trimester elastase activity, are associated with an increased likelihood of uncomplicated spontaneous vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: Women achieving uncomplicated spontaneous VD demonstrated significantly greater relaxation on third-trimester Pelvic Organ Prolapse Quantification for anterior, apical, and hiatal measures than those without uncomplicated spontaneous VD.
